Name: Close Doors
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Did you ever notice that interior doors can't be closed after being opened? And NPCs don't ever close doors after opening them?

This mod lets you close doors that are opened, and makes NPCs close doors after walking through them.

That's all.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url], you can also change the colors in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
